tasks.title: Connect both start choices
tasks.nextAction: Implement a shared choice between booking a call and starting online. Keep typed and voice input within the online path.
tasks.notes: Several main calls to action promise a 30-minute call but open a 7–12 minute AI intake. The existing Calendly session works. Safe technical changes are being staged; no audit fix is published.
acceptanceCriteria: Every start button opens the intended choice and working destination.
Labels accurately describe the call and online intake.
An authorized test verifies booking or intake routing and confirmations.

tasks.title: Approve Roadmap purchase logic
tasks.nextAction: Ask Tai to approve a consistent offer specification before changing commercial copy or checkout behavior.
tasks.notes: The site describes a paid Roadmap credited toward a build, while monthly checkout says preparation starts after payment. A free initial preview, included monthly planning and separate deep planning remain proposals.
acceptanceCriteria: The site, proposal, checkout and receipt use the same approved offer.
Planning is not charged twice.
Credit eligibility and exclusions are explicit.

tasks.title: Define recurring billing rules
tasks.nextAction: Obtain the approved scope, capacity, term, renewal, cancellation, refund, credit and third-party cost rules.
tasks.notes: Balanced is described as $4,500 per month with an 18-month build horizon, while Stripe continues until canceled. The delivery horizon must not be presented as a spending cap without an approved agreement.
acceptanceCriteria: The website, offer, Stripe checkout and receipt agree.
Recurring obligations and any minimum term or end condition are clear.
The delivery horizon is distinguished from any contractual spending limit.

tasks.title: Explain seller and policies
tasks.nextAction: Confirm the relationship to Elite Web Solutions LLC, the receipt identity and the approved merchant policies.
tasks.notes: Stripe checkout names Elite Web Solutions LLC. Merchant Terms and Privacy links are not exposed. Legal wording and seller relationships must not be invented.
acceptanceCriteria: Actual merchant policy links are available before input or payment.
The seller identity is consistent across the site, checkout and receipt.
Tai has approved the relationship explanation and policy content.

tasks.title: Ground intake privacy promises
tasks.nextAction: Confirm the providers, data uses, access, retention, deletion and human-review practices before revising the notice.
tasks.notes: The online intake accepts text, voice and attachments and makes absolute privacy promises without an exposed merchant notice. The wording needs operational evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: The intake notice accurately describes actual operations.
An authorized submission verifies routing and error handling.
Absolute promises are removed or supported by confirmed practices.

tasks.title: Align service scope language
tasks.nextAction: Ask Tai to confirm service names and scope boundaries, then align the existing pages.
tasks.notes: The services page presents eight capabilities and scores, but inclusions are inconsistent. New public services and five proposed service families need a separate owner decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Each service explains its problem, deliverables, exclusions, client inputs, proof and start path.
Existing names are used consistently.
No offer implies that every capability is included without approval.

tasks.nextAction: Prepare complete article content or an explicit withdrawal decision for each unfinished promoted article.

acceptanceCriteria: Each promoted article has approved complete content or an explicit withdrawal decision.
Reading time reflects the actual body.
Headings and alternative text are meaningful.

tasks.title: Reconcile case-study proof
tasks.nextAction: Reconcile card and detail milestone counts against canonical data, then review outcome evidence and reuse permission.
tasks.notes: Reported card/detail counts differ for six examples: private milestone build 4/3, founder-led business 5/4, leadership education 6/5, e-commerce brand 6/5, financial advisory firm 6/5 and health and wellness 7/6. Technical corrections are being staged; claim and permission review remains separate.
acceptanceCriteria: Card and detail counts match the same canonical data.
Outcome claims have supporting evidence and required reuse review.
Proposed work is clearly distinguished from completed work.

tasks.title: Repair Roadmap preview controls
tasks.nextAction: Implement real behavior for enabled preview controls and remove unintended timeline overflow.
tasks.notes: The Economics control does not change the Build Order view. The timeline was reported wider than its 1,165-pixel viewport. A separate website task is staging this repair.
acceptanceCriteria: Every enabled control has real behavior or is clearly static.
Existing business-type tabs continue to work.
No unintended overflow occurs at widths of 320, 375, 768, 1,180 and 1,440 pixels.
Keyboard focus and selected states are clear.

tasks.title: Substantiate numbers and promises
tasks.nextAction: Collect sources and definitions for each number, then ask Tai to approve or qualify absolute claims.
tasks.notes: The About page has an unexplained 266 and a five-year durability promise. The services page shows scores of 78, 55, 40 and 62 and a claim about nothing below 9. These require substantiation, not replacement with invented metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Every published number has a clear definition and source.
Absolute claims are approved and supported or appropriately qualified.
Forecasts are conditional and do not double-count overlapping benefits.
The human voice and The Roadmap name are preserved.

tasks.title: Map legacy destinations
tasks.nextAction: Verify legacy destinations and stage only deliberate, relevant redirects.
tasks.notes: Candidates include /our-work to /case-studies, /services to /what-we-build, /blog to /insights and /contact-us to an approved start path. FAQs, career and legacy service URLs require individual review. The new article’s existing redirect must remain intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Relevant permanent redirects use a single hop.
Unknown URLs return a genuine 404 instead of a blanket Home redirect.
Sitemaps, canonicals and internal links are consistent.
The previously verified article permalink and old-URL redirect continue to work.

tasks.title: Repair search and accessibility
tasks.nextAction: Include the featured article in search and counts, and repair skip-link and modal focus behavior.
tasks.notes: The audit found eight articles versus seven library items, no search match for the featured title, a missing #main target in Balanced checkout and intake Escape returning focus to BODY. A separate website task is staging this repair.
acceptanceCriteria: Featured articles appear in search and library counts are consistent.
The skip link moves focus to main content.
Closing the intake returns focus to the exact trigger.
Pages have a coherent H1 structure.
Existing focus trapping and empty-submit protection continue to work.
